description: The bare `onclick=risky()` and the `${}` `onclick=${risky()}` handler forms, each an unhandled call to a `!` function. E-ERROR-002 fires once per handler — twice.
rationale: §19.4.3 / §19.4.4 — an unhandled `!` call SHALL be E-ERROR-002 in every event-handler form. The bare call form is the shape the S439 corpus measure found in use (6 sites, migrated at S440).
